best_printed: FIX 1: Init at mean — 21% old memory retention
notes: Retention is the old memories' summed activation at step 500 divided by their sum just before step 250, as the notebook computes it.

The activations at step 250 are not printed. Steps 0 to 249 are the same in all three arms (same memories, seed reset before each arm), so the old memories' sum at step 250 is the same in all three: about 0.284, worked out from each arm's printed retention and old finals. The figure's bars agree.

This notebook changed two photo links from test 1. The memory labelled 'horse' uses the spaniel puppy photo the other runs label 'puppy'. The memory labelled 'puppy' uses a new photo, of a tabby cat. Every slot is a photo; there is no random vector.
The notebook's header comment lists a third fix, boosting old memories' replay for a while, but the notebook does not run it.
Decay rates are drawn in list order from seed 42, so each position gets the same rate as in test 1.
